017package org.apache.juneau.http.classic.resource;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.io.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.http.UnmodifiableBean;
023import org.apache.juneau.http.classic.entity.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.http.classic.header.*;
025
026/**
027 * A streamed, non-repeatable resource that obtains its content from an {@link Reader}.
028 *
029 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
030 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauRestCommon">juneau-rest-common Basics</a>
031 * </ul>
032 */
033public class ReaderResource extends BasicResource<ReaderResource> {
034
035   /**
036    * Constructor.
037    */
038   public ReaderResource() {
039      super(new ReaderEntity());
040   }
041
042   /**
043    * Constructor.
044    *
045    * @param contentType The entity content type.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to omit an explicit <c>Content-Type</c> header.
046    * @param contents The entity contents.  Can be <jk>null</jk>, in which case a {@link NullPointerException} is thrown when the resource's content is read.
047    */
048   public ReaderResource(ContentType contentType, Reader contents) {
049      super(new ReaderEntity(contentType, contents));
050   }
051
052   /**
053    * Copy constructor.
054    *
055    * @param copyFrom The bean being copied.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
056    */
057   protected ReaderResource(ReaderResource copyFrom) {
058      super(copyFrom);
059   }
060
061   @Override /* Overridden from BasicResource */
062   public ReaderResource copy() {
063      return new ReaderResource(this);
064   }
065
066   @Override /* Overridden from BasicResource */
067   public ReaderResource unmodifiable() {
068      return this instanceof UnmodifiableBean ? this : new Unmodifiable(this);
069   }
070
071   /**
072    * An unmodifiable snapshot of a {@link ReaderResource}.
073    */
074   public static class Unmodifiable extends ReaderResource implements UnmodifiableBean {
075
076      /**
077       * Constructor.
078       *
079       * @param copyFrom The bean to snapshot-copy.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
080       */
081      @SuppressWarnings({
082         "java:S1699" // Paradigm intentionally calls the overridable freeze() from the ctor to deep-freeze sub-beans.
083      })
084      protected Unmodifiable(ReaderResource copyFrom) {
085         super(copyFrom);
086         freeze();
087      }
088
089      @Override /* Overridden from BasicResource */
090      protected ReaderResource modify(Runnable mutation) {
091         throw uoex("Bean is unmodifiable.");
092      }
093   }
094}
